name: even-keel-badge
description: The Cloudflare Worker behind an Even Keel project's README badge: stores the pushed chain state and draws it as SVG

BADGE.description: The KV namespace that keeps the last pushed state of each badge.

BADGE_SECRET.description: The push secret: any long random string. Even Keel sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`; put the same value into Even Keel's badge settings.
